name: Representation Maps and Unique-Sink Orientations
hypotheses: Finite ample binary class and its intrinsic one-inclusion graph.
statement: A map is a representation map exactly when it is the out-map of an intrinsic unique-sink orientation. Under this dictionary, acyclic unique-sink orientations are exactly corner peelings and characterize dismantlable ample classes.
proof: The CCMW orientation theorem converts the non-clashing bijection to the out-map cube and unique-sink axioms and reconstructs the map in the reverse direction. Their acyclic case orders vertices by successive sinks, which is equivalent to reversing a corner peeling.
